title: Recording: This Be Called A Song by Ringo Starr | 1976
content:
Cherokee Studios, Los Angeles
Producer: Arif Mardin

Ringo Starr recorded ‘This Be Called A Song’ for his fifth studio album, Ringo’s Rotogravure, on 25 May 1976.

‘This Be Called A Song’ was written by Eric Clapton, who also played guitar on the recording.

On 17 June additional vocals were recorded, on the same day that Paul and Linda McCartney contributed to ‘Pure Gold’.
